remarks: Spacious 4-bedroom, 3- full bathroom townhome plus loft with a versatile floor plan in a beautifully maintained San Dimas community. The dramatic living room features soaring ceilings, tall windows that provide abundant natural light, and a two-sided gas fireplace shared with the separate family room. The main level also offers a formal dining area, a breakfast nook between the kitchen and family room, and sliding doors opening to a large enclosed courtyard—perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, and entertaining. A downstairs bedroom and full bathroom provide an ideal arrangement for guests, extended family, or a home office. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a private bath
